Short title and commencement

ZAKAT AND USHR (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ZAKAT AND USHR
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Zakar and Ushr Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part‑I, 7th August, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002‑Pub.
dated 7‑8‑2002.‑‑‑The following Order
promulgated by the President is hereby published for general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Zakat and Ushr (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 8, Ordinance XVIII of 1980

ZAKAT AND USHR (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ZAKAT AND USHR
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Zakar and Ushr Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part‑I, 7th August, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002‑Pub.
dated 7‑8‑2002.‑‑‑The following Order
promulgated by the President is hereby published for general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 8,
Ordinance XVIII of 1980.‑‑‑In the Zakat and Ushr
Ordinance, 1980 (XVIII of 1980), in section 8, in clause (c), in the first
proviso, in clause (ii); for the semicolon and word "and" a colon
shall be substituted and thereafter the following proviso shall be added,
namely:‑‑
"Provided that where
expenditure on the administrative organization of a District Zakat Committee is
not fully met by the Provisional Government due to paucity of funds during a
financial year, the Central Zakat Council may provide supplementary funds not
exceeding two percent. from within the limit specified in clause (iii);
and"
